lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three roughly parallel horizontal trajectories of circular high-luminance pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills. The median trajectory contains the highest-intensity local maxima with approximately equidistant spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal trajectories at regular intervals, creating a grid-like matrix where high-luminance blobs are positioned at the vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient—bright superior edge and shadowed inferior edge—runs horizontally across the mid-flank from the pectoral region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the basal and anterior margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated, high-luminance linear feature is visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the primary ridge, consistent with a commensal remora. No clear mechanical tissue loss or permanent scarring is discernable.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency, small-scale point pattern is present on the rostrum and cephalic region anterior to the gill slits, contrasting with the larger-scale grid-based patterning on the lateral flank.
